feeding_claim.verbatim: Our egg layers enjoy the freedom of our pastured fields.

notes: Small beginning farm near the Gerstle River bridge. Orders through a Local Line store (shop page could not be opened, so current products and prices unconfirmed); buyers choose pickup or delivery at checkout, but the site names no pickup point. Delivery to Tok and Delta Junction is described as planned with dates to be set, so not recorded as a channel. Whole chickens are limited; buyers can ask to be notified when birds are ready. Herdshare page says a few raw milk herd shares are available ($100 buy-in, weekly milk for share owners), but it does not say whether the herd is cows or goats, so no dairy species or dairy_products added; verifier should confirm. Raw milk is legal only in some states. No feed details beyond pasture.
